title: Useful AppSumo Software Deals for Freelancers
subtitle: Discover practical software options currently available as lifetime deals on AppSumo to support your freelance business.
html:
Disclosure: this post contains affiliate links. If you buy through them, I may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.

Running a freelance business means wearing many hats. Juggling client communications, website management, and administrative tasks can quickly drain your time and energy.

Many independents rely on a stack of monthly subscriptions that eat into their profits. Finding alternative ways to manage projects and clients without ongoing fees is a smart goal for any small business owner.

Project.co: Manage client work, request payments, and track hours

This platform helps you keep your client projects organized in one central place. You can manage tasks, request payments directly, and track billable hours without switching between multiple apps.

One important caveat to keep in mind is that lifetime deals depend on the company staying in business, so always review the current plan limits and check the refund window on the AppSumo deal page.

See the Project.co deal on AppSumo

MonSpark: Monitor website performance and functionality

Keeping an eye on your online presence is crucial when you build and maintain sites for clients. MonSpark offers performance tracking and functionality monitoring with real-time notifications when issues arise.

Before making a purchase, remember that lifetime software access requires trusting the provider's long-term roadmap, and you should carefully verify the specific feature limits listed on the deal page.

See the MonSpark deal on AppSumo

Storeplum: Build a successful ecommerce website

If you build online shops for clients or sell products yourself, this platform provides a way to set up an ecommerce site designed to drive sales and support growth.

As with any lifetime software purchase, make sure to check the exact platform limits and review the refund policy on the deal page to ensure it fits your current business needs.

See the Storeplum deal on AppSumo

TruConversion: Easy funnel tracking and optimization

Understanding how visitors interact with a website helps you deliver better results for clients. This tool provides heatmaps, session recording, and form analytics for straightforward funnel tracking and optimization.

Be sure to inspect the plan tiers on the AppSumo deal page for visitor or recording limits, and remember that lifetime software availability depends on the ongoing operations of the vendor.

See the TruConversion deal on AppSumo

Robomotion: Automate repetitive and manual tasks

Data-intensive manual tasks can consume hours of your workweek. Robomotion lets you set up easy-to-use robotic process automation bots to handle those repetitive chores for you.

Keep in mind that software purchased through lifetime deals relies on the vendor maintaining support, so read the fine print regarding updates and check the refund window before buying.

See the Robomotion deal on AppSumo

How to choose

When reviewing these options, think about the specific bottlenecks in your daily workflow. Choose tools that solve an immediate problem rather than collecting software you do not currently need.

Always take a moment to read the deal terms, feature limits, and refund policies directly on the AppSumo page before completing your purchase.

This article was written with AI assistance from the deal information AppSumo publishes. Check each deal page for current terms before you buy.
